snippet.title: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Announcement Trailer | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
Get ready to saddle up for a ride through the Wild West with Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster — a faithful modernization of the 1997 LucasArts classic, Outlaws™! 

Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster includes the 1998 expansion Handful of Missions, up to 4K resolution support at 120FPS, cross-play multiplayer with four action-packed game modes, a Vault brimming with behind-the-scenes content, upgraded gameplay, high-resolution textures, redrawn art, enhanced rendering, and modern gamepad support complete with a new weapon wheel, rumble, and motion/gyro controls.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster will release on Xbox One, Series X|S, PlayStation 4|5, Nintendo Switch, and PC platforms later this year, with pre-orders available now!
===================================
